article:
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Robot staff
A restaurant in a small town in the UK has just got a new employee. But rather than being the usual helpful, friendly person you (21).................. in a restaurant, this employee is a robot! Katie Jones, the restaurant's owner, explains why she wanted to have a robot worker. She says it was (22).................. the fact that it is hard to get new staff from the local area. She also thought it might (23).................. more customers. And indeed, she has had bookings from large (24).................. of people who heard about the robot and wanted to come and see it for themselves! The robot's job is to collect food from the kitchen and take it to the tables, which it does well. However, for things like taking orders and (25).................. bills, human waiters are still the best (26)................... .

questions.explanation:
B. imagine
“imagine in a restaurant” 表示 “想象中在餐厅里的（人）”，符合 “机器人不像想象中普通员工” 的语境。
A. understand（理解）、C. believe（相信）、D. guess（猜测）均不与 “在餐厅场景中的预期” 匹配。
拓展：“imagine” 后可接名词或动名词，如 “imagine working with a robot”（想象与机器人共事）。

D. partly
“partly because” 表示 “部分原因是”，与 “当地招工难是部分原因” 的逻辑一致。
A. nearly（几乎）、B. fairly（相当）、C. hardly（几乎不）均不用于 “部分原因” 的表达。
拓展：“partly” 常与 “mainly”“chiefly” 对比使用，如 “Partly because of the weather, and mainly because of his illness...”（部分因天气，主要因他生病……）。

B. attract
“attract more customers” 表示 “吸引更多顾客”，符合 “机器人可能成为餐厅卖点” 的语境。
A. attend（出席）、C. accept（接受）、D. allow（允许）均不与 “customers” 构成 “吸引” 的动宾关系。
拓展：“attract” 的名词形式为 “attraction”，如 “tourist attraction”（旅游景点）。

D. numbers
“large numbers of people” 为固定搭配，意为 “大量的人”，强调因机器人而来的顾客数量多。
A. totals（总数）、B. figures（数字）、C. levels（水平）均不与 “large...of” 搭配表示 “大量”。
拓展：“a number of + 复数名词” 表示 “许多”，谓语动词用复数；“the number of” 表示 “…… 的数量”，谓语动词用单数。

A. dealing
“dealing bills” 表示 “处理账单”，“deal with” 为固定短语，意为 “处理”。
B. finishing（完成）、C. answering（回答）、D. solving（解决）均不与 “bills” 搭配。
拓展：“deal with” 可接 “problems/tasks/bills” 等，如 “deal with customer complaints”（处理顾客投诉）。

C. choice
“human waiters are the best choice” 表示 “人类服务员仍是最佳选择”，符合 “机器人无法完全替代人类” 的语境。
A. preparation（准备）、B. result（结果）、D. advantage（优势）均不与 “最佳” 搭配表达 “选择” 的含义。
拓展：“choice” 常见搭配：“make a choice”（做选择）、“the best choice for...”（对…… 的最佳选择）。
